title: UNIT 8 – BEFORE YOU READ – READ – COMPREHENSION
rawTitle: UNIT 8 – BEFORE YOU READ – READ – COMPREHENSION

items.scene: Arnold: My name is Arnold. I have an apple tree. It keeps me busy all year. I watch small buds grow on my apple tree. They grow into apple blossoms. I watch honeybees collect nectar from the blossoms. I make a swing for my apple tree. I build a tree house in my apple tree. My apple tree shades me from the hot sun. I watch small apples begin to grow. I juggle some green apples for my tree friend. My apple tree now has big, red, tasty apples. I bring some leaves up to my tree house. I make a soft floor to lie on. I shake the branches. Red apples fall to the ground. I put them in a basket and take them home. My family and I make apple pies. In the winter, snow falls. It's quiet. The branches of my apple tree are bare. I hang strings of popcorn and berries on the branches. The birds eat them. I build a snowman. The snow melts. It's spring again.
items.prompt: What kind of tree does Arnold have?

items.hint: Look for the evidence. Listen again if you need to.
items.why: an apple tree Evidence: “I have an apple tree.”

items.scene: Arnold: My name is Arnold. I have an apple tree. It keeps me busy all year. I watch small buds grow on my apple tree. They grow into apple blossoms. I watch honeybees collect nectar from the blossoms. I make a swing for my apple tree. I build a tree house in my apple tree. My apple tree shades me from the hot sun. I watch small apples begin to grow. I juggle some green apples for my tree friend. My apple tree now has big, red, tasty apples. I bring some leaves up to my tree house. I make a soft floor to lie on. I shake the branches. Red apples fall to the ground. I put them in a basket and take them home. My family and I make apple pies. In the winter, snow falls. It's quiet. The branches of my apple tree are bare. I hang strings of popcorn and berries on the branches. The birds eat them. I build a snowman. The snow melts. It's spring again.
